commit_23a83cfa.commit: 23a83cfa fix(leave-in): accept verified heat use without label timing (unmerged; only on codex/catalog-assessment-completeness; main HEAD 404db24f lacks it)
commit_23a83cfa.change: Deletes the evaluator branch that returns mismatch 'Die Anwendung vor Hitze ist nicht bestätigt.' when role=pre_heat_application and application_stage lacks pre_heat; pre_heat_application now needs only providesHeatProtection=true + verified_complete protocol (+ the shared checks). Adds a test; implements Nick's 2026-09-18 ruling in plans/2026-09-17-scan-assessment-catalog-completeness.md.
commit_23a83cfa.relevant_to_group_B: YES, decisive. Gliss, Olaplex, Redken have hp=true on a C2 claim and directions that are silent about heat (towel_dry/dry_hair only). §7.13 forbids inferring pre_heat, so the DB cannot be made to pass under the old evaluator without violating the contract; with 23a83cfa they pass with no DB change.
commit_23a83cfa.relevant_to_group_A: Partly. It does nothing for hp=false (still 'Hitzeschutz ist nicht verifiziert'); the Group-A fix is hp false->true from the claim research. After that, Alcina, Neqi Build Boost, Neqi Moisture Mystery behave like Group B (stage silent) and need 23a83cfa; Pantene HEAT&GLOW (directions 'Föhnen, um zu aktivieren') and Urban Alchemy ('Föhnen, stylen oder an der Luft trocknen') carry pre_heat in their directions and pass either way; Pantene Bonding only if its page-only claim is accepted and 'Als Hitzeschutz für nasses Haar' is read as pre_heat.
commit_23a83cfa.contract_consistency: Consistent with §7.13 (stage stays a pure directions transcription, never derived) and §13.3 / adapter doc (adapter already emits pre_heat_application and required role pre_heat_protection from the heat binary alone). The residual product risk: a claim-only heat binary (no L9 member, 8 of 9 products) now suffices for a pre-heat recommendation with shared protocol timing. That is Nick's stated ruling, not a reviewer proposal.
